supersedes_for_repair: WU-05 prohibition on every new public symbol

api_decision.reason: Rust has no workspace-private/friend visibility; the existing dependency graph already connects krylov to integrators to CLI, while Cargo graph changes would force an unnecessary campaign rebuild and evidence rebind.
requirements: bridge modules and every directly exported bridge item use #[doc(hidden)]
new bridge names start with K0 or contain _k0_ or _for_k0
no existing production function signature changes
no Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, feature, crate, or dependency changes
call sites are limited to K0 receipt code, the atomic K0 CLI, and K0 tests
ordinary production paths do not import or call either bridge

findings.repair: validate cell v2 identity, exact scientific configuration, nonempty campaign payload, hard gates, raw payload digest, and exhaustive stage coverage

findings.failure: aggregate raises instead of preserving a validator-valid ERROR cell
findings.repair: catch per-cell execution/parse/validation failures and serialize a cell-v2 ERROR receipt with identity, phase, command, exit status, log digest, and preserved work

findings.failure: schema accepts information-free ERROR or STOP_INVALID receipts
findings.repair: use conditional stage-v2 and cell-v2 schemas; failure states require a nonempty structured failure object and preserved-work metadata

findings.failure: required telemetry crossed crate boundaries through unauthorized public API

evidence_migration.rule: Create v2 wrapper receipts referencing SHA-256 of every raw WU-04 payload. Do not rerun the expensive 12-cell campaign when solver outputs and raw payload bytes are unchanged. Rerun only if a repair changes equations, tolerance, routing, convergence, stage work, or numerical payload bytes.
required_parity: same numerical outputs and work counters

repair_order: orchestrator merge current package tip into the clean fresh-review head
write RED reproducers for all five findings
implement the public bridge and evidence/schema repairs
migrate raw WU-04 evidence to v2 wrappers without rerun if parity holds
run targeted tests and fresh read-only repair review
only then push and open the draft stacked implementation PR
